title: Proactive Early Warning for EV Battery Packs: A Concept Note on Reading the Recovery Speed of the BMS Voltage Signal
summary: The battery management system of an electric vehicle records cell voltage, current and temperature many times a second. Every current method that uses these signals to detect degradation is either reactive, acting after a fault code is raised or a capacity threshold is crossed, or trained, requiring labelled examples of degradation events to build a model. This note proposes a proactive layer that needs neither. It watches how quickly the small, cycle-level voltage fluctuations return to their normal level after each disturbance. review.reason: Proposes a voltage-recovery signal for early, label-free degradation detection in EV battery packs.
